spans.s: Taṇḍi, a ṛshi. § 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 14, 607 (Brahmayoninā, recited the 1000 names of Śiva); 16, 1037 (ṛshiḥ, in Kṛtayuga, worshipped Śiva), (1049), 1103, 1104, 1111, 1113 (taught Upamanyu the 1000 names of Śiva); 17, 1116 (ṛshiṇā), 1136 (ºkṛtaḥ, obtained the 1000 names of Śiva from heaven), 1137, 1283 (praised Śiva with the 1000 names), 1288, 1289 (communicated them to Śukra). Cf. Brahmayoni.
